description: Minecraft servers only: install a modpack (modpackId + versionId from list_gameserver_modpacks) like the panel library. The server type and Minecraft version follow the modpack and the server is reinstalled with it; other installed variants keep their data. To update the active modpack use update_gameserver_version with targetModpackVersion. Requires confirm=true. Requires an active ZapX Pass (see server instructions).

serviceId.description: ID of the Gameserver: the "id" field from list_account_services or list_gameservers (e.g. "cmabc123..."). The numericId shown in the panel (e.g. "180") is accepted too. IDs of other service types do not work here.

name: install_gameserver_modpack
title: Install Minecraft Modpack
